info.name: NEC - Training Schedule API

request.description:
Creates a new training schedule.

Request body fields:
- trainingClassId: Long (required)
- fromDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
- toDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
- timeSlot: String (required, max 100 chars)
- venue: String (required, max 200 chars)
- location: String (required, max 200 chars)

Response data shape:
{
  "id": Long,
  "scheduleCode": String,
  "trainingClass": { "id": Long, "value": String },
  "fromDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "toDate": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "duration": Integer,
  "timeSlot": String,
  "venue": String,
  "location": String,
  "isActive": Boolean,
  "createdBy": String,
  "createdAt": LocalDateTime,
  "updatedBy": String,
  "updatedAt": LocalDateTime
}

Returns HTTP 201 on success.

body.raw:
{
  "trainingClassId": 1,
  "fromDate": "2026-07-01",
  "toDate": "2026-07-07",
  "timeSlot": "09:00 AM - 01:00 PM",

  "location": "Kampala, Uganda"

request.description:
Updates an existing training schedule by its schedule code.

Path variable:
- scheduleCode: String (e.g. TS-001)

Request body fields (all required):
- trainingClassId: Long (required)
- fromDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
- toDate: LocalDate (required) — format: YYYY-MM-DD
- timeSlot: String (required, max 100 chars)
- venue: String (required, max 200 chars)
- location: String (required, max 200 chars)

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of training schedules with optional filters.

Query params:
- page: int (default 0)
- size: int (default 10)

Request body (all fields optional — send {} to get all records):
- scheduleCode: String
- trainingClassId: Long
- fromDate: LocalDate (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
- toDate: LocalDate (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
- venue: String
- location: String
- isActive: Boolean

Returns HTTP 200 on success.

Activates or deactivates a training schedule by its schedule code.

Path variable:
- scheduleCode: String (e.g. TS-001)

Query param:
- isActive: Boolean (required) — true to activate, false to deactivate

Returns HTTP 200 on success.
